submission_lock_rule: After accepted real first submission, draft membership/return method/pickup fields are no longer editable. A material correction creates a new replacement Fault Tag and new membership identities. A false-submission correction may restore the same tag to Draft while preserving the corrected historical snapshot; a later real submission creates a new event/snapshot.
invariants: Fault Tag tracking identity is immutable/non-reusable
pickup Dispatch Location is pickup origin, never warehouse destination
submitted membership snapshots are immutable exact evidence and master-data changes never rewrite them
warehouse receipt is distinct from final decision and never closes the RMA obligation by itself
warehouse acceptance/rejection always requires explicit operator confirmation even when Communications supplied proposal evidence
accepted closes the obligation while rejected preserves an actionable open obligation for resend
material submitted correction uses replacement lineage rather than in-place history rewrite
implementation_rule: Both leaves are one normative Fault Tag schema family; all original exclusivity, lineage, append-only and index obligations remain mandatory.
